description.zh:
需要审批拒绝的命令ID。
> 您可以通过接口[ListApproveCommands](~~2584310~~)查询所有需要审批的CommandId。
description.en:
The ID of the command that you want to reject.

> You can call the [ListApproveCommands](~~2584310~~) operation to query the IDs of all commands that need to be reviewed.

description.zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeInstances](~~153281~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the bastion host.

> You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to query the ID of the bastion host.

description.zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。
> 地域ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见[地域和可用区](~~40654~~)。
description.en:
The region ID of the bastion host.

> For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

descriptions.zh:
本接口用于管理员审批拒绝运维员的命令执行申请。

本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
Rejects an O\&M engineer's command execution request as a Bastionhost administrator.

You can call this operation up to 10 times per second per account. If the number of the calls per second exceeds the limit, throttling is triggered. As a result, your business may be affected. We recommend that you take note of the limit when you call this operation.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost reject-approve-command --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --command-id 574 --region cn-hangzhou
